name: speed-changer
description: Play videos at 2x & faster on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok — everywhere! Control the speed right from the page using on-page controls.
author: Sarkis Andreyan <sarkis@andreyan.com>

scripts.build:chromium: tsc && npm run cleanup && vite build --mode chromium
scripts.build:edge: tsc && npm run cleanup && vite build --mode edge
scripts.build:gecko: tsc && npm run cleanup && vite build --mode gecko
scripts.build:safari: tsc && npm run cleanup && vite build --mode safari
